Privacy Policy

Last updated October 8, 2026. This page explains what information the phone line and this website handle, why, and who receives it.

  1. Home
  2. Privacy Policy

Who this policy covers

Phoenix Pool Cleaning Pro is a d/b/a of Dominion Digital Group. It runs the website phoenixpoolcleaningpro.com and the phone line published on it. It is a free referral line, not a pool company: it answers calls and transfers callers to independent, locally owned pool service companies. Below, "the line" refers to Phoenix Pool Cleaning Pro, and "pool company" means an independent business you are connected with.

What the line collects when you call

An automated assistant answers each call. To connect you, it collects what you choose to say, which usually includes:

  • your name and the phone number you are calling from or would like a call back on;
  • the town, neighborhood or general area of the pool;
  • a short description of the pool problem or the service you want.

The phone system may also keep a basic record of the call, such as the time, length and calling number. The assistant turns what you say into the short summary the pool company hears before it picks up.

What the website collects

The website has no forms and does not ask you for personal information. Like most websites, the hosting service may log basic technical data when you visit, such as your IP address, browser type, the pages requested and the time. If you use the EN/ES language toggle, the page loads Google's translation tool and stores a small cookie that remembers your language choice; Google's own privacy terms apply to that tool.

How the information is used

  • To transfer your call to an independent pool company that takes calls for your area, and to give that company a short summary before it answers.
  • To pass your name, callback number, area and pool problem to that company if it cannot answer, so it can call you back.
  • To run, secure and improve the phone line and the website, and to keep records the business needs.
  • To meet legal obligations or respond to lawful requests.

Who receives it

The details from your call go to the pool company you are connected with. Once it has them, that company handles them under its own policies, because it is a separate business. The line also uses service providers, such as phone, call handling and website hosting providers, that process information only to provide those services.

Calls and texts from the pool company

A pool company you are connected with may contact you by phone or text about your request; ask that company about its own messaging and opt-out practices.

How long it is kept and how it is protected

The aim is to keep call records only as long as reasonably needed to operate the line, handle follow-up questions and meet legal or accounting needs, and to protect them with reasonable safeguards. No phone or internet system is free of risk.

Your choices

You can decide what to say on a call, and you can hang up at any time. To ask about the information the line holds about a call you made, or to request a correction or deletion where the law allows, call the line at (623) 240-0428 and leave your request. To ask a pool company about information it holds, contact that company directly.

Children

The line and website are meant for adults arranging pool service for a property. Children under 13 are not the audience, and their information is not knowingly collected.

Updates to this policy

As the line changes, so may this policy. The date at the top marks the current version. This page describes the line's practices; it is not legal advice.

Phoenix Pool Cleaning Pro is a free phone line, not a pool company. It answers your call and connects you with an independent local pool service company, which inspects, quotes and does the work, and which you pay directly. Companies may pay a referral fee. You never pay the line.
